comment: Per-file typecheck counts for the test tree, and the ratchet in `scripts/typecheck-per-file.js` refuses a file
**Recorded 2026-10-10, from a run of `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json` that produced 35 errors in 5 files.** The
baseline was empty before this, so every one of them read as *new* - **and the reason they surfaced today is
that the lint gate began reading the package test directories**, which put the same files in front of a typed
tool for the first time. **A baseline records what is there so that a change to it is visible**; it is not a
claim that the errors are acceptable, and **the count is the number a fix has to bring down.**
